thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: p99 latency alert fired for service=runtime-us-west (threshold=2.0s). source=automated-slo. routes: /v1/generate-text, /v1/chat. rolling p99=2.6s, p95=1.1s. paging level=page (no escalation yet).

oncall-jen: acked. I'm looking at traces and infra now. Can anyone confirm if this is regional or model-specific? :eyes:

sam_rt: seeing concentrated spike on /v1/generate-text in us-west, CPU/GPU utilization on the hosts is normal. KV-cache hitrate dropped from 88% -> 47% around 09:12PT. Likely cache thrash + short-lived batching imbalance.

lucas: KV hotkey symptoms fit. Also seeing sudden increase in very long seq requests (>> typical seq len), which busts batch target. p99 tokens-per-request jumped 3x.

oncall-jen: ok. immediate mitigations: 1) enable fallback routing to smaller model variant for new requests 2) enforce per-request max-seq limit for the route 3) bump dedicated pool by +2 nodes in us-west to buy headroom.

amanda_support: notifying customers on the impacted tenant list now (Acme Corp, BetaApps). ETA for status update ~10m. I'll post templates in #support-ops.

sam_rt: rolling a quick routing change: `redwoodctl route update --route /v1/generate-text --fallback redwood-ggml-small --region us-west`

oncall-jen: nice. also throttling max-pending-requests for that route: `redwoodctl config set rate_limit.pending /v1/generate-text 200`

lucas: I'm triggering a warmup on the new nodes and priming KV cache for top-50 prefixes. command: 
```
infractl scale pool runtime-us-west +2
infractl prime-kvcache --prefix-file top-prefixes.txt --pool runtime-us-west
```

incident-bot: PagerDuty: page escalation in 5m unless ack changes. Current ack: oncall-jen.

oncall-jen: I'll keep the page. sam, can you confirm whether autoscaler suppressed growth before we scaled?

sam_rt: autoscaler logs show backoff due to transient cpu steal on 3 instances; scale requests were batched and delayed by ~80s. Not ideal. Filed PR to adjust cooldowns.

oncall-jen: customer impact: Acme's bulk inference jobs may see >2s tail latency; interactive sessions degraded. Amanda, advise comms: include recommended workaround (switch to lower-accuracy model) and ETA 20-30m.

amanda_support: sending initial message now. tagging Acme CSM. cc: legal for high-SLA customer.

lucas: cache warmup priming is running, KV hitrate climbing back to ~70%. if that continues p99 should drop under 1.8s.

sam_rt: after fallback routing, new-request p99 improved to 1.9s. overall p95 unchanged yet.

oncall-jen: good. keep monitoring. I'll stay on this for handoff. If p99 stays <2.0s in 15m, we'll resolve and close pager. otherwise escalate to SRE lead.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: page suppressed (auto) — incident-bot set status=investigating.

amanda_support: posted customer note: "We're investigating tail latency affecting interactive usage for some customers in us-west. Temporary workaround: use the lower-latency model variant listed in your account console. We're estimating mitigation within 30 minutes."

lucas: one more note: we should add a guard in runtime to avoid large-seq requests being coalesced into single huge batches. filing follow-up ticket.

oncall-jen: thanks team. I'll post a follow-up in 10m with metrics and next steps. :thumbsup:
